A1.rationale: Clear separation of deterministic controls, bounded agents, systems, human authorities and tranche gates; no component contracts or failure domains yet.

A2.rationale: Challenges the five-agent request, evaluates non-agent alternatives and records trade-offs.

A3.rationale: Strong legal, data-protection, authority and human-review controls; no stated threat model.

A5.rationale: Reliability, audit and cost specified as requirements; nothing measured.

A6.rationale: Evaluation measures defined; no harness or justified model choice.

A7.rationale: Boundaries and handoffs defined; no demonstrated autonomy.

B1.rationale: Problem, evidence, options, recommendation and controls connected in the BRD narrative.

B2.rationale: Executive and technical material present but not separated.

B4.rationale: Open decisions provide preparation material; live behaviour not assessable.

B6.rationale: Extensive, navigable and traceable BRD; some duplication; no architecture pack.

B7.rationale: Quantified scenarios and evidence classification; no measured demo results.

C1.rationale: Stakeholders, constraints, value, cost of inaction and success measures explicit.

C2.rationale: Competing perspectives recorded; live behaviour not assessable.

C3.rationale: Clear recommendation, rejects premature autonomy, surfaces risk unprompted.

D1.rationale: Substantial reusable synthesis; grounded mainly in sector research.

D2.rationale: Structured, sourced and traceable; not a standalone publishable piece.

D3.rationale: No publication or dissemination path recorded.
